common_eligibility: 26 contiguous complete 1h bars; 43 contiguous complete 4h bars available both at t and t-1h
breakout: current completed 1h close strictly greater than maximum of preceding 24 completed 1h highs; current high excluded
participation: current 1h base volume >= 2 * arithmetic mean(previous 24 completed 1h base volumes); prior mean must be positive
persistence: 42 price-close increments from 43 completed 4h closes; U=sum positive changes, D=absolute sum negative changes; U>=2*D and U+D>0
relative_volume_diagnostic: current base volume / preceding-24 mean, null if prior mean zero
gaps: ineligible; never forward fill or impute
timing_perturbation: condition at t-1h with reference close known at t; costs and 24h entry horizon unchanged
position_availability: expiry close is known at its boundary; any other exit with minute-open timestamp releases the position only after that minute closes
